lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # RESOURCES.md Format

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: `RESOURCES.md` is the curated set of trusted sources for this topic. Knowledge for explainers should be drawn from here, not from parametric guesses. Wisdom comes from the communities listed here.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Structure

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ```md

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # {Topic} Resources

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Knowledge

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - [Book: _The Science and Practice of Strength Training_ — Zatsiorsky & Kraemer](https://example.com)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Foundational text on programming and adaptation. Use for: anything to do with periodisation, recovery, intensity zones.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - [Article: "How Much Should I Train?" — Greg Nuckols (Stronger By Science)](https://example.com)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Evidence-based review of volume landmarks. Use for: weekly set targets per muscle group.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Wisdom (Communities)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - [r/weightroom](https://reddit.com/r/weightroom)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: High-signal subreddit, moderated against bro-science. Use for: programme critique, plateau troubleshooting.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Local: Tuesday strength class at {gym name}

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Use for: real-time coaching feedback on lifts.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Rules

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **High-trust only.** Prefer primary sources, recognised experts, peer-reviewed work, and communities with strong moderation. If a resource is marketing dressed as education, leave it out.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Annotate every entry.** A bare link is useless in three months. Add one line: what it covers and when to reach for it.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Group by Knowledge / Wisdom.** Mirrors the philosophy in [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md). It is fine for a resource to appear in only one group.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Surface gaps explicitly.** If no good resource exists for an area the mission needs, write a `## Gaps` section listing what is missing. This drives future search.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Prune ruthlessly.** A resource that turned out to be wrong, shallow, or off-mission should be removed, not buried. Better five sharp sources than thirty mediocre ones.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Record community preferences.** If the user has opted out of joining communities, note it here so future sessions don't keep proposing them.
